walkthrough: Identify the vibration of point P: on a stationary wave every point performs SHM with frequency $250\text{ Hz}$, and P starts at its negative amplitude of $-1.0\text{ mm}$.
Calculate the period using $T = 1/f = 1/250\text{ Hz} = 0.0040\text{ s} = 4.0\text{ ms}$.
Express the waiting time as a number of periods: $5.0\text{ ms} / 4.0\text{ ms} = 1.25$, so the time is one full period plus one quarter period.
After one full period of $4.0\text{ ms}$ point P returns to $-1.0\text{ mm}$, then in the extra quarter period of $1.0\text{ ms}$ it moves from the extreme back toward equilibrium.
In SHM starting at an extreme, a quarter period later the displacement is zero, so after $1.25T$ the displacement of P is zero. This is option B.
